PACE 2024 OSCM development-data source notice

This notice covers the fixed solver-oscm-pace2024-development-data product:
100 Exact Track public instances and 73 public test-set instances.

Distribution scope
------------------
The combined product is local_prepare with public_upload_allowed=false.
The 100 Exact Track public instances have no upstream data license in the
official page, archive, or archived website repository. No data license is
asserted for them. Local preparation does not grant a right to upload the
combined product or a derived image publicly.

The MIT license in PACE2024-Testsets-MIT.txt covers only the 60 medium and
13 tiny test-set instances from PhKindermann/Pace2024-Testsets. It does not
cover the 100 Exact Track instances, hidden judging data, reference answers,
the verifier, development tools, backends, or complete development images.
The test-set MIT terms do not make the combined product publicly
redistributable.

Reconstruction
--------------
The two pinned ZIP archives are transport containers. Members are copied as
binary plaintext with no newline, encoding, graph-content, or compression
transformation. Output paths and modes are the only changes: all 173 outputs
are regular files with mode 0644. The retained manifest fixes every output
path, byte count, and SHA-256. Upstream README, LICENSE, directory entries,
and the exactly declared solution-member names are accepted for archive
validation; upstream solution files are not read into or copied to the
product. Undeclared, duplicate, linked, special, or path-traversing members
are rejected.
